visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a full-body green spandex suit is seen lying on a turquoise yoga mat in a minimalist, brightly lit white studio. He performs a slow upward stretch similar to a cobra pose, his face fully covered by the green fabric. The lighting is even and studio-grade. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom where the man in the green suit is vigorously brushing his teeth. His face is partially visible through the suit's opening. He wears green gloves while holding the toothbrush. The background is a tiled gray bathroom wall. (3) He leans over a chrome faucet to drink water directly from the tap, the water splashing against his face and the green hood. The sink is white porcelain, and the lighting is bright indoor lighting. (4) The man pours a bag of ice into a clear bowl already filled with water on a white table. He then plunges his entire face into the ice water, holding his body tense. A green glass bottle stands next to the bowl. (5) A close-up shot shows the green glass bottle falling and shattering into many small fragments on a gray tiled floor. The man is then seen walking out of the bathroom with a yellow towel draped over his shoulder. (6) He presses the red power button of a dark gaming PC tower with Gigabyte branding. The internal fans and RGB lights flicker on. He then uses a mouse to click a desktop icon for the game League of Legends. (7) The man is intensely focused, playing the game. Close-ups show his hands in green gloves clicking a black mouse and tapping on a backlit mechanical keyboard. Intercut is gameplay footage showing a character performing a massive battle in a forest environment. (8) He exits a building and runs through a parking lot and near modern architectural buildings. He is wearing pink slippers while sprinting at high speed. The camera follows him with a tracking shot as he slides across the pavement. (9) Back indoors, he prepares a red plastic tub filled with dark liquid and ice. He puts on swimming goggles over his green hood and fully submerges himself in the tub, blowing bubbles. (10) A large man in a black t-shirt appears with two companions in an outdoor hallway, confronting the camera. The green suit guy is then shown back in the red tub, screaming and thrashing as green liquid splashes everywhere. (11) A final screen appears with several lines of Chinese text in yellow and green against a blurred background, advertising a collaboration and a new game mode.

The sound is dry and close-miked, with no noticeable reverb, indicating a small, enclosed indoor space. (3) The acoustic texture shifts to the continuous broadband noise of rushing water from a faucet, followed by the percussive clinking of solid ice cubes against a glass container. This is followed by the rhythmic, soft thudding of footsteps on a tiled floor and the rustle of fabric. This is followed by the rapid-fire, percussive 'clack' sounds of a mechanical keyboard being typed on with high intensity and speed. This is followed by a loud, aggressive male voice speaking Chinese with high vocal arousal.
